patterns.message: Domain/application/ports must NOT import from main or renderer (Hexagonal-Lite dependency rule per ADR-001)

zones.message: ADR-001: core/domain MUST NOT import from core/application (Domain has no outward dependencies)
ADR-001: core/domain MUST NOT import from core/adapters
ADR-001: core/domain MUST NOT import from core/ports
ADR-001: core/domain MUST NOT import from core/infrastructure
ADR-001: core/domain MUST NOT import from src/main
ADR-001: core/domain MUST NOT import from src/renderer
ADR-001: core/domain MUST NOT import from src/presentation
ADR-001: core/application MUST NOT import from core/adapters (Application depends only on ports)
ADR-001: core/application MUST NOT import from src/main
ADR-001: core/application MUST NOT import from src/renderer
ADR-001: core/application MUST NOT import from src/presentation
ADR-001: core/ports MUST NOT import from core/adapters
ADR-001: core/ports MUST NOT import from core/application
ADR-001: core/ports MUST NOT import from src/main
ADR-001: core/ports MUST NOT import from src/renderer
ADR-001: core/ports MUST NOT import from src/presentation
ADR-001: core/adapters MUST NOT import from src/main
ADR-001: core/adapters MUST NOT import from src/renderer
ADR-001: core/adapters MUST NOT import from src/presentation
ADR-001: src/main MUST NOT import from src/renderer (presentation boundary)
ADR-001: src/main MUST NOT import from src/presentation (presentation boundary)
ADR-001: src/renderer MUST NOT import from src/main (presentation boundary; use IPC). Type-only imports of src/main/ipc/channels.ts are allowed.
ADR-001: src/presentation MUST NOT import from src/main (presentation boundary; use IPC). Type-only imports of src/main/ipc/channels.ts are allowed.
